name: Byoubugaura Sakurako
source:
President of the student council at the school. She is strict about the school’s code of conduct and does not tolerate any disturbances to order. A rigid and strict girl who thinks logically and rationally. Because of her rigid nature, her knowledge about matters of sexuality is limited. In reality, she has a gentle and domestic side, but as the student council president responsible for managing the students, she deals with them strictly.

(Translated from: DLsite)
